exams.name: AFA Certified Farrier
exams.blurb: Mid-level farrier credential combining a written examination with forging and live horse shoeing practical tests.

exams.name: AFA Certified Journeyman Farrier
exams.blurb: Advanced farrier credential requiring written testing plus demanding forging and shoeing modules judged against national standards.

exams.name: AFA Therapeutic Endorsement
exams.blurb: Specialty endorsement for Certified Journeyman Farriers demonstrating therapeutic and corrective shoeing skill for lame or diseased hooves.

exams.name: Certified Behavior Consultant Canine – Knowledge Assessed
exams.body: Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers
exams.blurb: Examination for canine behaviour consultants covering aggression, fear, separation issues, assessment and behaviour change protocols.

exams.name: Certified Professional Dog Trainer – Knowledge and Skills Assessed
exams.body: Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers
exams.blurb: Video-based skills assessment for CPDT-KA holders demonstrating hands-on training of loose-leash walking, recall and stay behaviours.

exams.name: Certified Professional Dog Trainer – Knowledge Assessed
exams.body: Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers
exams.blurb: Multiple-choice examination on learning theory, instruction, husbandry and ethology for dog trainers with documented training hours.

exams.name: NACA Certified Animal Control Officer Level 1
exams.blurb: Entry training and examination for animal control officers covering law, safe capture, investigations and field documentation.

exams.name: NACA Certified Animal Control Officer Level 2
exams.blurb: Second-tier animal control training covering cruelty investigation, evidence handling, courtroom testimony and dangerous animal response.

exams.name: NACA Certified Animal Control Officer Level 3
exams.blurb: Advanced animal control curriculum on supervision, complex cruelty cases, disaster response and agency management practices.

exams.name: Beef Quality Assurance Certification
exams.blurb: National producer training and assessment covering cattle handling, animal health products, records and food safety on beef operations.

exams.name: Certified Animal Welfare Administrator
exams.body: The Association for Animal Welfare Advancement
exams.blurb: Examination for leaders of animal shelters and welfare organisations covering governance, finance, operations and community programmes.

exams.name: Certified Equine Massage Therapist
exams.blurb: Training and practical assessment in equine sports massage covering anatomy, palpation, stroke technique and contraindications.

exams.name: Certified Feline Master Groomer
exams.body: National Cat Groomers Institute of America
exams.blurb: Written and hands-on testing in cat-specific grooming including handling, bathing, dematting, lion trims and skin condition recognition.

exams.name: Certified Professional Animal Scientist
exams.body: American Registry of Professional Animal Scientists
exams.blurb: Species-focused examination for animal scientists working in nutrition, management and production across livestock and companion animals.

exams.name: Certified Veterinary Practice Manager
exams.blurb: Examination in veterinary practice finance, human resources, law, marketing and organisational management for hospital administrators.

exams.name: Certified Wildlife Rehabilitator
exams.blurb: Examination covering intake, nutrition, housing, zoonoses and release criteria for people rehabilitating native wild animals.

exams.name: EAS Master Beekeeper Certification
exams.blurb: Four-part written, oral, practical and laboratory examination covering colony management, bee biology, disease and public outreach.

exams.name: IAABC Certified Dog Behavior Consultant
exams.body: International Association of Animal Behavior Consultants
exams.blurb: Case-study and examination pathway for consultants resolving complex canine behaviour problems using science-based intervention plans.

exams.name: Karen Pryor Academy Certified Training Partner
exams.blurb: Assessed professional programme in clicker training and positive reinforcement teaching for dog trainers and behaviour professionals.

exams.name: Landscape Industry Certified Horticultural Technician
exams.blurb: Written and hands-on testing of plant identification, installation, maintenance, irrigation and safety for horticultural technicians.

exams.name: National Certified Master Groomer
exams.body: National Dog Groomers Association of America
exams.blurb: Written and practical testing across sporting, non-sporting, terrier and long-coated breed groups for professional dog groomers.

exams.name: NAVTA Approved Veterinary Assistant
exams.body: National Association of Veterinary Technicians in America
exams.blurb: National assistant credential earned through an approved programme and examination covering restraint, nursing care and clinic operations.

exams.name: North American Veterinary Licensing Examination
exams.blurb: Required licensing examination for veterinarians in the United States and Canada, testing entry-level clinical competence across species.

exams.name: Veterinary Technician National Examination
exams.body: American Association of Veterinary State Boards
exams.blurb: Credentialing examination for veterinary technicians covering pharmacy, anaesthesia, dentistry, laboratory procedures and nursing.

exams.name: Veterinary Technician Specialist
exams.body: NAVTA Committee on Veterinary Technician Specialties
exams.blurb: Advanced credentials awarded by recognised academies in areas such as anaesthesia, emergency, dentistry, behaviour and internal medicine.
